Package index

Fit, tune and compare sparse models

l0glmFit()
Fit generalized linear model with \(L_0\) or grouped row-\(L_0\) regularization subject to optional nonnegativity constraints
l0glmTune()
Tunes the regularisation parameter lambda of an L0glm fit
l0nnPois()
Fast nonnegative identity-link Poisson L0 or grouped L0 penalized fit
sparseGLM() coef(<sparseglm>) plot(<sparseglm>)
Fit, tune and compare sparse regression methods
l0glmMetrics()
Essential fit and recovery metrics for an L0glm model
preclustering
Preclustering response channels before sparse GLM fitting
compulsory_terms
Nonnegative compulsory terms and smooth backgrounds
predictor_groups
Select groups of predictor variables
interaction_models
Staged selection of interaction terms
local_search
Final local support refinement

Screening, simulations and solvers
